items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Mr. Russell, it was the Casinos.

ctx.x: Yeah, okay. There's still another name that Fess told us and somebody else had mentioned once too. Kid Thomas mentioned the name of the hall over there and it's still one we haven't mentioned yet. I just can't think of it. It's in my mind, but I just can't get a hold of it.
This hall, I'm trying to think now because... Around Elmira there. It was on Elmira Street. At that time, if I'm not making a mistake, Mr. Russell, it was the Casinos.
